service.description: Print a document at a facility: a shipment's package labels (documentType shipmentLabel or returnLabel, the PDF the gateway gave) or a screen (documentType screen, rendered as PDF by print#ScreenDocument), on the printer the facility binds for printerPurposeEnumId (FacilityPrinter in effect, with its copies) or a printer given that is bound there; or, with printJobId, the same document again (a reprint, send#PrintJob). Each print runs in a transaction of its own and never undoes what was posted before it: the answer says printed, or why not (PRINTER_NOT_BOUND, PRINTING_UNAVAILABLE when this build has no print client, PRINT_FAILED, NO_LABEL, DOCUMENT_UNAVAILABLE) with the print jobs to reprint. Requires a warehouse permission (SHIPMENT_SHIP or SHIPMENT_PACK for labels; for other documents also SHIPMENT_PICK, STOCK_RECEIVE, STOCK_MOVE, STOCK_COUNT, STOCK_ADJUST, QUALITY_INSPECT or FACILITY_EDIT); refuses a facility outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a shipment of another facility, a printer not bound there (PRINTER_UNAVAILABLE) and an unknown document (DOCUMENT_INVALID).

actions.script: for (const field of Object.keys(answer)) context[field] = answer[field]

service.description: What each printer takes (PDF; no ZPL yet) and what its last print job says about it (used, failing, or unavailable when this build has no print client), for a printer, a facility's bound printers, or every printer. Requires a warehouse permission; refuses a facility outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: printers
parameter.description: networkPrinterId, description, location, serverHost, printerName, pdf, zpl, formats, lastJobStatusId, lastJobDate, lastJobError, availability

service.description: A facility's printer for a purpose (FacilityDetail's Printers tab): the printer, its copies (1 to 20) and the dates it is in effect, or with endNow the binding ended now. Requires FACILITY_EDIT; refuses a facility outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an unknown purpose (PURPOSE_INVALID) or printer (PRINTER_INVALID), COPIES_INVALID, DATES_INVALID.

actions.script: for (const field of Object.keys(answer)) context[field] = answer[field]
